title: Lock the Private Key
story: A private key that everyone can read is not private. Keys should be readable only by their owner.
goal: Make /home/learner/.ssh/id_rsa readable and writable only by you (mode 600).
hints: chmod changes the permission bits. 6 means read plus write, and 0 means nothing.
socratic: Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
